top_15.title: The Game at Carousel: A Horror Movie LitRPG
top_15.added_decision: Actual knowledge and what an enemy thinks you know can differ.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: make declared or apparent awareness distinct from actual awareness in a local encounter rule.
top_15.future_proof: Compare a warned observer who maintains the role with one who openly reacts.

top_15.title: Dungeon Reset
top_15.added_decision: One carrier can be exempt while the surrounding world refreshes.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: let a local reset spare one tagged carrier, creating construction and resource loops. Read reset scenes before choosing what is spared.
top_15.future_proof: Reset one room and inspect body, belongings and construction separately.

top_15.title: To Another World... with Land Mines!
top_15.added_decision: An offered benefit need not expose its real drawback.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: information about a power can be a purchasable resource separate from the power itself.
top_15.future_proof: A reliable guide reveals one concealed condition before a grant is chosen.

top_15.title: Fine Structure
top_15.added_decision: An old true measurement can become obsolete when the world changes.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: a discovery receipt stores the rule version under which it worked, and later trials can fail under a changed local law.
top_15.future_proof: Keep a successful trial receipt; show a later failure under a new rule version.

top_15.title: Godclads
top_15.added_decision: A power holder can contest which local law applies.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: model a stolen source separately from its authority to change a world rule.
top_15.future_proof: Two authorities conflict over one action; record winner and affected scope.

top_15.title: The Book Eating Magician
top_15.added_decision: The carrier is spent while understanding and usable method transfer separately.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: transfer practical skill by consuming a knowledge carrier, with preparation and provenance gates.
top_15.future_proof: A learner receives one method while the consumed copy is no longer teachable.

top_15.title: Trafford's Trading Club
top_15.added_decision: One payer loss can sustain a different beneficiary.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: track what a customer relinquishes separately from what the broker gains, with explicit ownership and consent.
top_15.future_proof: Show payer, desired outcome, broker gain and unresolved liabilities on one receipt.

top_15.title: Making Magic: The Sweet Life of a Witch Who Knows an Infinite MP Loophole
top_15.added_decision: A real loophole can compound instead of paying a fixed cost.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: a known craft can manufacture the input to its own capacity growth, with explicit local costs.
top_15.future_proof: One allowed daily operation increases capacity; do not invent its source formula.

top_15.title: Astral Apostle
top_15.added_decision: Body, local identity and returning traveler can have distinct owners.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: give each projected life a local body and identity while tracking a separate traveling self.
top_15.future_proof: One traveler changes vessels while the old local biography stays attached to its person.

top_15.title: Return of the Runebound Professor
top_15.added_decision: A rebuilt body can retain a damaged soul.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: give revival separate body recovery and persistent soul damage records.
top_15.future_proof: After one permitted revival, clear bodily injury but retain a named soul wound.

top_15.title: D-Genesis: Three Years after the Dungeons Appeared
top_15.added_decision: A transferable ability can expire before delivery or sale.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: sell a transferable ability whose useful lifetime creates real delivery and inspection problems.
top_15.future_proof: A custody transfer succeeds before expiry and fails honestly afterward.

top_15.title: Pale Lights
top_15.added_decision: Patron preferences and a fixed signed term need not be identical.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: distinguish contract text, patron mood and an external social consequence.
top_15.future_proof: Keep the original bargain alongside a later change in patron mood.

top_15.title: I Can See Your Death
top_15.added_decision: Seeing a clear future and being able to alter it are different claims.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: a reading has separate certainty and intervention status; apparent inevitability stays an observer claim until tested.
top_15.future_proof: Show a precise reading with an untested intervention flag, then record the actual attempt.

top_15.title: The Oracle Paths
top_15.added_decision: Opponents can also act on predictions.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: preview quality depends on which other actors also possess and act on guidance, rather than assuming passive opponents.
top_15.future_proof: Revise a preview when another informed actor changes their intended action.

top_15.title: Losing Money to Be a Tycoon
top_15.added_decision: A deliberate bad plan can be defeated by helpful independent agents.
top_15.what_we_take: Proposal: use a reward system whose accounting objective conflicts with the helpers' own goals.
top_15.future_proof: Separate intended loss, staff interpretation, actual profit and the system payout.
